canonical_project: RATCH Group Ratchaburi Power Plant Data Center Hub (2,000+ rai land conversion)
owner: RATCH Group PCL (via Ratchaburi Electricity Generating Holding / Ratchaburi power plant site)
notes: Kaohoon (2026-07-03, Thai business press reporting company statements): Ratchaburi power plant - RATCH Group's flagship 99.99%-owned IPP - has ended its 25-year PPA with EGAT (2 blocks ended Oct 2025, 3 more in 2026, ~2,170 MW expiring); RATCH plans to repurpose the >2,000 rai site, which has a 1.7M m3 water reservoir, EGAT 230kV/500kV substations and PTT gas pipeline, toward new S-curve businesses including DATA CENTER supporting AI/cloud, saying the site could support ~500 MW and possibly up to 1 GW power draw. Company is in early feasibility talks with investors; no BOI filing, permit, SPV, or MW commitment yet. Per methodology status = announced/planned (company intent, land signal), grade B (Thai trade press); related: Raimon Land-RATCH 'sustainable data centers' MoU (2026) likely refers to Nava Nakorn Pathum Thani site, not Ratchaburi.
